summary: Turn market indicators and commercial data into defensible decisions. Explore the five-day course and review its practical Excel exercises.
lede: Business data analytics for market trends uses commercial and external evidence to interpret shifts in demand, competition, and market conditions. For commercial analysts, product managers, and strategy professionals, the course builds a structured approach to market and pricing decisions using CRISP-DM and Excel, including preparing datasets, calculating indicators and price-volume-mix measures, comparing scenarios, and presenting findings with assumptions and limitations clear.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use commercial evidence to assess market movement, explain performance, or recommend product and pricing decisions.
prerequisites: Bring working familiarity with business performance measures and routine spreadsheet use. No programming is required. The exercises use Excel and supplied sample files.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
